summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all nine paragraphs of the selected Greek, including its denials, negative question, speaker changes, desire-as-sin assertion, heavenly honor, reconciliation language, hopelessness, and complete healing promise. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both retain the disclosed working readings rather than harmonizing alternatives, and contextual repentance follows current policy without adding conditions. The witness notes are consistent with the supplied attributed reports and distinguish corrections and editorial emendations from other readings. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure of those reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify external editions, or establish exhaustive collation or a unique interpretation.
